unexpected_user_workspace_mutation_detai: Before the fixture-retarget regression was added, stale/global focus retargeted a diagnostic menu or shortcut action to user-owned w2Y and created at least one pane split. The evidence does not establish an exact created-pane count, so none is asserted.
unexpected_mutation_response: App input was stopped and the diagnostic app was terminated immediately. Because w2Y is outside fixture ownership, no generated pane was closed or otherwise cleaned up by this run.
